text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With training time fast approaching,
Sakura Laurel was out shopping when—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"I speak French.
Is there something I can help you with?"

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
""Oh, thank goodness! I got completely lost...
Could you tell me how to get to the station?""

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"I understand... It's easy to get lost around here,
so if you'd like, I can walk you to the station!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Je vous en prie. Bon voyage !

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu, I'm glad I could guide you without any trouble!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Speaking in French was so much fun♪
I got to talk about our sightseeing plans and all sorts of things!
Even Parisian fashion trends...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, huh? Is it really this late already!?
I totally forgot about training!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Sakura Laurel
ended up skipping training.
